desc:
Welcome to SPRUNKI MORPH! 🎵
Explore. Discover. Transform.

Find and unlock 100+ Sprunki morphs hidden across a world full of secrets!

🧩 Complete quests and solve mysteries.
🏆 Find hidden trophies and collect morphs.
⚔️ Defeat monsters to unlock new characters.
🎡 Spin the wheel and try your luck!

Explore different locations:
- Main Island
- Sprunki Houses
- Beach
- Ruined Village
- Cave Maze
- Sewers
- Backrooms
- Squid Game Arena
- Secret Room
- ???
Some Sprunkis are easy to find. Others will make you work for it… 👀

Play with friends and see who can discover the most!
More morphs, locations and adventures coming soon.

Made by Sprunki fan, for Sprunki fans. 💚
